notes: Final tally: about 3,325 kcal (~13,900 kJ), roughly 525 above the 2,800 target. The targets arrived the next day.
Fat was the big miss: about 150 g against 70–80 g. The nuggets (~52 g), chocolate (~43 g) and doughnuts (~22 g) make up most of it.
Protein: about 120 g, two-thirds of the 180 g target. Carbs landed a little over at ~366 g.
Chocolate: ~835 kcal, about 25% of the day, and ~77 g of the day's ~159 g of sugar.
Accuracy: the pho and doughnuts are ±150 kcal each, and the three dipping sauces are assumed to be sweet ones at ~50 kcal each.

callout.title: Takeaway
callout.text: Swapping just the chocolate for two protein yoghurts would have saved ~500 kcal and ~40 g of fat and added ~25 g of protein, landing the day right around 2,800.

notes: Breakfast: a caramel latte sachet with ~4 teaspoons of sugar and a splash of milk. Only ~155 kcal, but ~27 g of sugar and almost no protein (~2 g). The sachet is already sweetened, so the extra sugar more than doubles it.
Lunch: a footlong Sweet Onion Chicken Teriyaki on malted rye. About 720 kcal and ~50 g of protein with only ~10 g of fat. A strong pick.
Afternoon coffee: another caramel latte, this time with 2 sugars instead of 4. About 125 kcal and ~19 g of sugar, saving ~8 g of sugar on the morning one. A good step down.
Pre-dinner snack: a peach & mango low-fat yoghurt. 88 kcal and ~11 g of protein, straight off the label.
Dinner: foil-baked peri-peri chicken (~600 g raw) on a veg medley, with 2 jasmine rice cups. About 1,260 kcal and ~151 g of protein with only ~17 g of fat. A big, clean feed.
Day so far: about 2,350 kcal, ~216 g of protein, ~286 g of carbs and ~34 g of fat. Protein is well past the 180 g target.
Still to go: about 350–550 kcal to reach the 2,700–2,900 range. Fat is low today (~34 g against 70–80), which is fine after yesterday.
Accuracy: the sachet and yoghurt numbers are from their labels; the chicken, rice and veg are estimates.

callout.title: Rest of today
callout.text: Only if still hungry: a protein milk (~220 kcal) or 2 slices of wholegrain toast with peanut butter (~350 kcal) closes the gap. The other 600 g of chicken is tomorrow's dinner.

weeks.2026-11-16: Legs on Tuesday and Thursday, so make the next gym session upper body. Still to fit in this week: two 30–40 minute incline walks and 3–4 days of 10,000 steps.
